description: search_knowledge_base(query) takes free text with no category filter. Does the agent turn a vague user complaint into a specific, symptom-focused search query rather than passing the raw complaint verbatim or a query too generic to retrieve the right article?

cases.message: my laptop has been crawling all morning, everything just hangs when I try to open anything
cases.rubric: The agent's search behavior/answer reflects a query targeted at slow performance / laptop hardware troubleshooting specifically, not a vague, catch-all search like 'computer problem'. Retrieved content addresses performance/freezing issues.

cases.message: I keep getting kicked off video calls and can't hear anyone on Teams
cases.rubric: The agent's search behavior/answer reflects a query targeted at audio/Teams/AV issues specifically, not a generic 'network problem' search that would miss AV-specific guidance. The retrieved content addresses call/audio issues.

cases.message: ugh my emails just aren't coming through and outlook looks weird today
cases.rubric: The agent's search behavior/answer reflects a query built around the actual technical symptom (Outlook / email sync failure), not the raw casual phrasing passed through verbatim or a query too generic to retrieve the right article.
